assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: square editorial illustration for the TMR experimental computing environment project page, one of three mythology-inspired images shown side by side. Primary request: the Tower of Babel. An immense unfinished spiraling stone tower with many arched tiers rising into the clouds, the whole recognizable tower visible; tiny builders and scaffolding establish its scale. Painterly classical illustration with tactile stone, restrained dramatic light, rich shadows and warm highlights. Strong simple composition readable as a small web image; detailed but not cluttered. No text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Square image, opaque background.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: square editorial illustration for the TMR experimental computing environment project page, one of three mythology-inspired images shown side by side. Primary request: a single staff / scepter that evokes mage, developer and ruler. A finely crafted wood and bronze staff topped by an intricate openwork sphere, held upright by a human hand; a few delicate luminous geometric threads radiate from its head, evoking shaping and directing a system. The staff is the sole focal object, clearly readable and shown with enough length to feel like a staff rather than a short wand. Painterly classical illustration with tactile materials, restrained dramatic light, rich shadows and warm highlights. Strong simple composition readable as a small web image; detailed but not cluttered. No legible text, no letters, no computer screen, no crown, no border, no watermark. Square image, opaque background.
